intro: Purpose beyond para que: formal connectors, a que after verbs of movement, and no sea que.
p.a fin de que.consejo: It takes the subjunctive and two different subjects: «a fin de que todos lo entiendan».
p.con el fin de que.consejo: Like «a fin de que»: subjunctive and another subject. With the same subject: «con el fin de» + infinitive.
p.con el objeto de que.consejo: It is very formal, from documents. It takes the subjunctive: «con el objeto de que nadie falte».
p.con vistas a.consejo: It goes with a noun or an infinitive: «con vistas a mejorar». The v sounds b.
p.no sea que.consejo: It takes the subjunctive and warns of a danger: «llévate el paraguas, no sea que llueva».
p.a fin de.consejo: It takes an infinitive if the subject is the same: «a fin de ahorrar». With another subject: «a fin de que».
p.ayuntamiento.consejo: It is written with y: a-yun-ta-MYEN-to. It is where city paperwork is done.
p.medida.consejo: «Tomar medidas» means to take action. It also means size: «¿qué medida tiene?».
p.evitar.consejo: The v sounds b. A noun or an infinitive follows: «evitar el tráfico», «evitar llegar tarde».
p.mejorar.consejo: It comes from «mejor». The j sounds like a strong h: me-ho-RAR.
p.pasear.consejo: It comes from «paso». You say «pasear por el parque». It has two vowels together: pa-se-AR.
p.vecino.consejo: The feminine is «vecina». In Spain the c sounds «th»: be-THI-no.
b1.texto:
With **one subject**, purpose is a preposition + **infinitive**: **para**, **a fin de**, **con el fin de**, **con el objeto de**, **con vistas a**.

With **two subjects**, add **que** + **subjunctive**: **para que**, **a fin de que**, **con el fin de que**, **con el objeto de que**.

The tense follows the main verb: lo **hago** para que **estés** contento; lo **hice** para que **estuvieras** contento.

After a verb of movement (ir, venir, salir, subir…) Spanish uses **a**: vengo **a** verte; vengo **a que** me **expliques** esto.

**No sea que** + subjunctive warns of something bad you want to avoid: llévate el paraguas, **no sea que llueva**.

**¿Para qué?** asks for the purpose. **¿Por qué?** asks for the cause.
b2.titulo: A notice from the town hall
b2.f0.texto: The town hall has taken several measures in order to improve the traffic.
b2.f1.texto: They will close the centre to cars so that residents can walk around.
b2.f2.texto: There will also be more buses so that nobody needs a car.
b2.f3.texto: Technicians will go to the neighbourhoods so that residents can tell them their problems.
b2.f4.texto: With the festivities in view, the town hall wants to avoid traffic jams.
b2.f5.texto: Leave in good time, in case you find streets closed.
b2.f6.texto: Tomorrow I will go out early in order to stroll unhurriedly.
b4.texto:
**One subject → infinitive**:

- para + infinitive
- a fin de + infinitive
- con el objeto de + infinitive
- ir / venir a + infinitive

**Two subjects → que + subjunctive**:

- para que + subjunctive
- a fin de que + subjunctive
- con el objeto de que + subjunctive
- ir / venir a que + subjunctive

To avoid a danger: **no sea que** + subjunctive.
b4.e0.texto: I did it so that you would be happy.
b4.e1.texto: Speak slowly so that everybody understands you.
b4.e2.texto: Take the umbrella, in case it rains.
b5.f0.texto: This morning the city centre wakes up without the noise of engines.
b5.f1.texto: The residents go out for a stroll with their hands in their pockets.
b5.f2.texto: A girl chases the pigeons with a clear laugh.
b5.f3.texto: The town hall has placed green flowerpots all along the street.
b5.f4.texto: Everything seems made so that the air smells of bread and flowers.
b5.f5.texto: At midday the sun falls on the tables of the terraces.
b5.f6.texto: A waiter crosses the square with a tray full of glasses.
b5.f7.texto: Avoiding traffic jams has given the old streets their calm back.
b5.f8.texto: The older people sit on the benches with their faces to the sun.
b5.f9.texto: Nobody runs, lest the spell of the afternoon be broken.
b6.o0: cuando el sujeto es el mismo
b6.o0.refuerzo: Then «a fin de» + infinitive is enough.
b6.o1.refuerzo: Well done: with another subject you need «que» + subjunctive.
b6.o2.refuerzo: It works in any tense; what matters is the subjects.
b6.pregunta: When is «a fin de que» used?
b7.frase: Tomaron medidas a fin de ____ el tráfico.
b7.o0.refuerzo: That is it: the same subject asks for the infinitive.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Que» needs another subject and here there is only one.
b7.o2.refuerzo: It is a conjugated verb. With one subject the infinitive goes.
b7.pregunta: Complete with one subject: infinitive or «que»?
b8.frase: Cerrarán el centro para que los vecinos puedan pasear
b8.traduccion: The centre will be closed so that residents can walk around
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes: it warns of something you want to avoid.
b9.o1.refuerzo: That would be «dado que». «No sea que» is a precaution.
b9.o2.refuerzo: It expresses no wish, but prevention of a danger.
b9.pregunta: What does «no sea que llueva» express?
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «in case it rains».
b11.o0.refuerzo: Yes: after a verb of movement, «a que» + subjunctive.
b11.o1.refuerzo: «Por que» would express the cause, not the purpose.
b11.o2.refuerzo: «De que» is not used for purpose after «vengo».
b11.pregunta: Choose what follows «vengo» with another subject.
b12.o0.refuerzo: It asks about the cause, not the purpose.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Correct: «para» looks ahead, to the aim.
b12.pregunta: Which one asks about the purpose?
p.varias.consejo: Feminine plural of «vario». The v sounds like b: BA-rias.
p.medidas.consejo: Plural of «medida». In «tomar medidas» it means taking action.
p.cerrarán.consejo: Future of «cerrar», to close. The c before e is th, and rr is strong.
p.puedan.consejo: Subjunctive of «poder», to be able. The ue is a diphthong: PWE-dan.
p.autobuses.consejo: Plural of «autobús», bus. Stress on BU.
p.necesite.consejo: Subjunctive of «necesitar», to need. The c before e is th: ne-the-SI-te.
p.técnicos.consejo: Plural of «técnico». The accent falls on the e, which is stressed: TEK-ni-kos.
p.irán.consejo: Future of «ir», to go. The accent falls on RAN: i-RAN.
p.barrios.consejo: Plural of «barrio», a neighbourhood. The rr is strong: BA-rryos.
p.cuenten.consejo: Subjunctive of «contar», to tell. The ue is a diphthong: KWEN-ten.
p.fiestas.consejo: Plural of «fiesta», a celebration. The ie is a diphthong: FIES-tas.
p.atascos.consejo: Plural of «atasco», a traffic jam. Stress on TAS.
p.salgan.consejo: Subjunctive of «salir», to go out. Stress on SAL: SAL-gan.
p.encuentren.consejo: Subjunctive of «encontrar», to find. The ue is a diphthong.
p.cortadas.consejo: Feminine plural of «cortado», cut or blocked. Stress on TA.
p.entiendan.consejo: Subjunctive of «entender», to understand. The ie is a diphthong.
p.llévate.consejo: Imperative of «llevarse», to take away. The ll sounds like y: YE-ba-te.
p.motores.consejo: Plural of «motor», engine. Stress on TO: mo-TO-res.
p.salen.consejo: From «salir», to go out. Stress on SA: SA-len.
p.persigue.consejo: From «perseguir», to chase. The gu before i is silent: per-SI-ge.
p.colocado.consejo: Past participle of «colocar», to place. The c before o is k: ko-lo-KA-do.
p.huela.consejo: From «oler», but the o becomes «hue»: «huele», «huelo». The h is silent.
p.terrazas.consejo: Plural of «terraza». The rr at the start of the middle syllable is strong.
p.vasos.consejo: Plural of «vaso», a glass. The v sounds like b: BA-sos.
p.devuelto.consejo: Participle of «devolver», to give back. The ue is a diphthong: de-BWEL-to.
p.mayores.consejo: Plural of «mayor». Here it means older people. Stress on YO.
p.bancos.consejo: Plural of «banco». Here it means a bench, not a bank.
p.rompa.consejo: Subjunctive of «romper», to break. Stress on ROM.
p.hechizo.consejo: Here it means a magical atmosphere. The ch sounds like ch in «chico».
p.sujetos.consejo: Plural of «sujeto», the subject of a sentence. The j sounds like h.
p.distintos.consejo: Plural of «distinto», different. Stress on TIN: dis-TIN-tos.
p.tomaron.consejo: Past tense of «tomar», to take. Stress on MA: to-MA-ron.
p.ocurra.consejo: Subjunctive of «ocurrir», to happen. The rr is strong: o-KU-rra.
p.vengo.consejo: From «venir», to come. The v sounds like b: BEN-go.
p.expliques.consejo: Subjunctive of «explicar», to explain. The x sounds like ks.
p.esto.consejo: «Esto» refers to something unnamed close to you. It has no accent.
